prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints centered on low back pain and muscle tightness consistent with a lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury described is plausible for a collision of this type. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted stretching and strengthening exercises, and graduated activity instruction. Recovery was somewhat slower than typically expected for a strain of this kind, and the patient remained symptomatic for a longer period than the usual course would predict. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion were noted and support the reported injury. Neurological screening, straight leg raise, and reflex testing were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the lumbar region. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. Continued home exercise and gradual return to normal activities are recommended, with reassessment if symptoms persist.
